text: Free cozy demo: grow your own ingredients, then cook them in your own restaurant.
Water the crops, break a few rocks, and keep the pantry full.
Then open the doors. Take orders, pour drinks, and keep every customer happy.
Best part? When it's busy, the chef cooks and the waiter runs trays on their own, like a little ant farm.
There's even a beach to wander down.
The catch? Mining looks weak. The pickaxe barely seems to land.
Thirty-one of its thirty-two Steam reviews are positive, and it's in fourteen languages.
Think Stardew Valley meets Diner Dash.
Worth a dip for a slow evening. The full game is due November eleventh.
